milestones.title: Stats Social App Origin
milestones.description: Delta began as a Stats Social Media App: profiles, personal stat input, feed/social mechanics, leaderboards, comparison, HVS/value scoring, and AI coaching.
milestones.gained: Delta gained its first recovered product form: quantified personal metrics turned into identity, comparison, and guidance.

evidence.summary: Durable milestone admitting the recovered Stats Social Media App as Delta's earliest currently known origin.
Backfill evidence record preserving local iCloud, local Git reflog, Figma Make, and Drive-search evidence boundaries.

milestones.title: Longitudinal Personal Analytics / Health-Intelligence Transition
milestones.description: Delta moved from social stat scoring toward longitudinal personal analytics and early health intelligence organized around raw events, cautious signals, state, and reflection.
milestones.gained: Delta gained its first recovered longitudinal intelligence loop over user events.

evidence.summary: Prior origin projection preserving delta-backend evidence for the December 26 personal-analytics / health-intelligence artifact.

milestones.title: Durable Memory Architecture
milestones.description: Delta introduced explicit long-term, episodic, pattern, trace, and daily-context memory, moving memory from incidental persistence to a first-class intelligence substrate.
milestones.gained: Delta gained durable memory stores rather than relying only on event persistence and transient state.

evidence.summary: Prior origin projection preserving durable-memory evidence recovered from delta-backend history.

milestones.title: Conversational Delta
milestones.description: Delta became explicitly conversational with short-term conversation memory, user facts, memory injection, and derived state shaping replies.
milestones.gained: Delta gained a chat-first user experience grounded in memory and derived state.

evidence.summary: Prior origin projection preserving Conversational Delta evidence recovered from delta-backend history.

milestones.title: Inference-Driven Health Advisor
milestones.description: Delta matured into an inference-driven health advisor with baselines, readiness, causal reasoning, memory, recommendations, explanations, and outcome-learning components.
milestones.gained: Delta gained a fuller health-intelligence stack with reasoning, explanation, and learning-loop components.

evidence.summary: Prior origin projection preserving health-intelligence evidence recovered from delta-backend history.

milestones.title: Behavioral OS
milestones.description: Delta generalized beyond a health advisor into a behavioral operating substrate built around observed events, interventions, feedback, adaptation, policy effects, and persistent behavioral memory.
milestones.gained: Delta gained a generalized behavioral loop with persistent intervention and feedback state.

evidence.summary: Prior origin projection preserving Behavioral OS evidence recovered from delta-backend history.

milestones.title: Agent Supervisor Origin
milestones.description: The separate engineering-agent lineage began when delta-agent appeared as a bounded local supervisor and orchestration substrate for engineering work.
milestones.gained: Delta gained a distinct engineering orchestration runtime separate from the product-intelligence lineage.

evidence.summary: Prior origin projection preserving the engineering-agent supervisor origin.

milestones.title: Intelligence OS
milestones.description: Delta was explicitly reframed as a personal Intelligence OS, with health demoted from product container to domain family and shared substrate elevated as the architectural center.
milestones.gained: Delta gained a durable substrate-centered architecture with domains treated as capability packs.

evidence.summary: Prior origin projection preserving Intelligence OS evidence recovered from delta-backend history.

milestones.title: Shared-Substrate Proof Era
milestones.description: Delta formalized scenario-registry and proof/eval framing for the shared substrate, turning multi-domain transferability into a governed proof discipline.
milestones.gained: Delta gained explicit proof fixtures and scenario governance for substrate transfer across domains.

evidence.summary: Prior origin projection preserving shared-substrate proof-era evidence.

milestones.title: Agentic OS Direction
milestones.description: The engineering track became an explicit Agentic OS direction with supervised loops, routing, lanes, and codex-oriented execution scaffolding.
milestones.gained: Delta's engineering-agent line gained an explicit operating model centered on supervised agentic loops.

evidence.summary: Prior origin projection preserving Agentic OS direction evidence.

milestones.title: Shared LLM Agent Runtime
milestones.description: Delta's engineering stack gained a shared LLM agent runtime, creating a common execution substrate for multiple bounded agents rather than separate bespoke runtimes.
milestones.gained: Engineering agents gained a common model-runtime substrate.

evidence.summary: Prior origin projection preserving shared LLM runtime evidence.

milestones.title: Mission Control Live Qualification
milestones.description: Mission Control passed live runtime qualification as a bounded advisory orchestrator with explicit authority limits and evaluation expectations.
milestones.gained: Delta gained a qualified Mission Control orchestration layer in the engineering stack.

evidence.summary: Prior origin projection preserving Mission Control live qualification evidence.

milestones.title: Historian Runtime Becomes Bounded Dependency
milestones.description: Historian gained a committed read-only runtime inspection interface and became a bounded production dependency for Mission Control without gaining canonical authority.
milestones.gained: Mission Control could consume bounded Historian context directly through a read-only runtime interface.

evidence.summary: Prior origin projection preserving Historian runtime dependency evidence.

milestones.title: Failure Triage Second Qualified Specialist
milestones.description: Governance promoted Failure Triage to qualified handoff-only advisory/read-only use, making Delta's governed shared-agent substrate span more than one distinct qualified intelligent specialist without granting autonomous wake, repair, or execution authority.
milestones.gained: Delta gained a second qualified bounded specialist role on its governed shared-agent runtime.

evidence.summary: Prior origin projection preserving Failure Triage qualification evidence.

milestones.title: Architecture Review Third Qualified Specialist
milestones.description: Governance promoted Architecture Review to qualified handoff-only advisory/read-only use, making Delta's governed shared-agent runtime span a third distinct qualified intelligent specialist without granting canon mutation, Event Bus wake, approval, or execution authority.
milestones.gained: Delta gained a third qualified bounded specialist role with structural and institutional review semantics on the governed shared-agent runtime.

evidence.summary: Prior origin projection preserving Architecture Review qualification evidence.

story.headline: Delta began as a social stats/value-score app, then evolved through longitudinal personal analytics, health intelligence, Behavioral OS, and finally a governed Intelligence OS substrate.
story.summary: When comparing current work to early Delta mistakes, the correct origin baseline is now the Stats Social App and its quantified-worth/social-scoring assumptions, not only the later health-intelligence loop.
story.coreShift: The center of gravity moved from quantified-worth scoring and social comparison toward memory, evidence, feedback, governance, and bounded action.
story.truthBoundary: Historian remains temporal truth. The website renders a read-only presentation feed and does not mutate canon.

origin.title: Stats Social App Origin
origin.summary: Delta began as a Stats Social Media App: profiles, personal stat input, feed/social mechanics, leaderboards, comparison, HVS/value scoring, and AI coaching.
origin.currentTruthGuard: Origin evidence is historical context, not current canonical product identity.

interpretation.summary: Growth concentrated in agent workflows and their operating substrate.
interpretation.product_capability_assessment: Prospect workflows, collaboration and website surfaces expanded; code size alone is not product qualification.
interpretation.infrastructure_governance_assessment: Runtime, privacy, verification and evidence support grew alongside product capabilities.

limitations: unique_tests is the existing agent-centric static name counter, not executed tests or suite-wide qualification
Archive roots intentionally have no Git metadata; full resolved main hashes supplied in checkpoints
Same five-repository baseline scope; new sibling repositories are not added
Local main, not deployed or remote state
Schema/config growth includes tracked JSON evidence not excluded by existing methodology
Archive-based integration backlog is not measured: ignore the comparison backlog delta of zero; no worktree-health inference is valid.
Per-repository counts deduplicate within each repository; suite totals also deduplicate identical content across repositories, so row sums need not equal suite totals.

interpretation.summary: Recent growth is real platform maturation, but it is concentrated in delta-agent substrate, verification, continuity, and governance surfaces rather than downstream product-runtime expansion.
interpretation.product_capability_assessment: Limited direct product-surface growth. Backend, mobile, and jobs were flat across the baseline window; delta-site grew modestly.
interpretation.infrastructure_governance_assessment: Most net growth was infrastructure/governance heavy: observability, continuity, specialist/runtime support, qualification evidence, and tests.

limitations: unique_tests remains delta-agent-centric because the current parser counts node:test-style test definitions and does not produce equivalent cross-repo unique test counts for Python and Jest suites.
